system.description:
A small creature has bound itself to you: a bat, cat, owl, rat, raven, toad or weasel.

  • It works as the familiar from the Summon Familiar spell, without casting it.
  • You share its senses within 100ft without concentrating, and it can deliver your touch spells.
  • If it dies, another finds you after 1 week.
  • Witches can't take this feat; they already have a familiar.

Available to: Wizards, Clerics, Druids, Illusionists, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Sorcerers, Warlocks, Witches, Necromancers, and Artificers.
